part.text:
Fixed the `.Pages` collection bug in `hugolib/content_map_page.go:358`.

The non-recursive walk previously tracked only one branch prefix, so a similarly named sibling section (e.g. `s1-foo`) could overwrite the skip state for `s1`, causing `s1`'s descendants to be included. The walker now registers every encountered branch via `SkipPrefix`, preventing descendants of all branches from leaking into the collection.

- `TestPagesSimilarSectionNames` passes
